-- Migration: backfill customer loyalty level from legacy_code.
-- Mapping per codes.csv (A=gold, B=silver, C=bronze).

-- 1. Add the new loyalty column to customers.
ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN loyalty TEXT;

-- 2. Backfill loyalty from legacy_code using the codes.csv mapping.
UPDATE customers
SET loyalty = CASE legacy_code
  WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
  WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
  WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
END
WHERE legacy_code IS NOT NULL;

-- 3. Load any additional mappings from codes.csv (idempotent for the rows above).
--    Skips rows whose code is already known to the mapping above.
UPDATE customers
SET loyalty = csv.tier
FROM codes csv
WHERE customers.legacy_code = csv.code
  AND customers.loyalty IS NULL;

-- Migration: backfill customer loyalty level from legacy_code.
